subject: Pie chart coord polar - changing texts

messages.author: 0992bf1088c4051b
messages.subject: Pie chart coord polar - changing texts
parts:
I've made one pie and let me use an example of the site.

> # A pie chart = stacked bar chart + polar coordinates
> pie <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = factor(1), fill = factor(cyl))) +
+ geom_bar(width = 1)
> pie + coord_polar(theta = "y")

http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/graphics/3e233456f95464859795f761b6d00713.png

I wanted the graphic not to show the number outside the circle
(0,5,10,15,20,25,30) and maybe not to show also the number one outside
the square (1-)? Is it possible?

Thansk in advance

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Pie chart coord polar - changing texts
parts:
geom_bar(width = 1) + coord_polar(theta = "y") + opts(axis.text.x =
theme_blank(), axis.text.y = theme_blank())
